name: Cultist: Absolute Horror cuts Horrorbolt's and Wrath of the Black Empire's cast time natively (#1554)
contract: 300309 has two effects. Effect0 uses EffectApplyAuraName=340, an aura the engine binds to a nullptr handler (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:405, 'unknown Ascension aura'); its own EffectBasePoints=-1/DieSides=1 computes to 0 (SpellInfo.cpp:489), so it is an inert leftover that promises nothing extra and is not asserted here. Effect1 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue=10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), EffectBasePoints=-301/DieSides=1 giving a flat -300 ms, classmask dword1=48=16+32 (bits 4 and 5). Verified against Spell.dbc: 800416 'Horrorbolt' (dword1=16, bit4, base cast time 1500 ms from CastingTimeIndex=16) and 800413 'Wrath of the Black Empire' (dword1=288, bit5 set, base cast time 2000 ms from CastingTimeIndex=5) both match, delivering exactly the tooltip's '-0.3 sec' on each. No script needed.

steps.label: SETUP: Horrorbolt keeps its 1500 ms base cast time
SETUP: Wrath of the Black Empire keeps its 2000 ms base cast time
SETUP: an outside-the-mask spell (Psychic Suppression) is unaffected
Absolute Horror cuts Horrorbolt's cast time by 300 ms
